review_evidence: Directory survey: 244 Complex, 124 Contour, 64 Calculus, 63 SpecialFunctions, 58 Semigroups, 49 Sobolev, 43 Normed, 43 CompletelyMonotone, 42 InnerProductSpace, 38 PDE, 36 PositiveDefinite, 25 Fredholm, other subdirectories 1-13 files; every file ends in .lean.

Sampled the first file of each subdirectory (for example Bochner/BochnerTheorem.lean 20 decls, Holder/Algebra.lean 40, PositiveDefinite/AddGroup.lean 46, Semigroups/Basic.lean 38); all have declarations.

summary: Inspected all 61 listed files under TauCeti/Analysis. Every file contains formal mathematical declarations (theorems, definitions, lemmas, structures, classes, instances) with proofs. Topics include: complex analysis (conformal mappings, Riemann surfaces, Fuchsian groups, Schwarz-Christoffel formula), PDE (Green functions, regularity, local boundedness), ODE (Lyapunov-Perron fixed point), convex analysis (Legendre-Fenchel conjugate, subdifferential, Stiemke's lemma), functional analysis (Riemann surfaces, degree theory), special functions (multivariate Gamma, hyperbolic, complex powers), geometric analysis (Hopf lemma, strong maximum principle), and Sobolev spaces (embeddings, multiplication, weak derivatives). No file is a pure import aggregator, generated content, transcript, placeholder, or non-mathematical content. The previous review (RRV-b548fb076848-r1) also concluded 'retain all'.
